_comment: Hand-made follow-up design (2026-09-20): 6 participants x 2 norms over the 8 norms of the 25-norm set that no participant had kept in BOTH tests by then. The two norms with no violation-free test at all (occupation_seat_in_order, movement_move2_wait1) get 3 plays each, the other six 1 each; every slot pairs an allocation norm with a queue or trajectory norm. Not a balanced cycle (balanced_positions=false). Serve with DESIGN=experiment/human/study_design_followup6.json ./experiment/human/run_study.sh
